scope: Fixture-only adapter, existing candidate lookup and HTTP response resolver executed in Node.js; not an active Worker or Supabase integration
nativeHttpVerified: Filtered GET through native fetch to a temporary loopback fixture server
Backend 503 maps to resolver 503 and is not negatively cached before recovery
Stalled response body triggers deadline and abort signal

resolverContract.unavailable: 503 with generic error code and no-store

adapter.allowedOrigins: HTTPS .test hostnames or HTTP/HTTPS literal loopback/localhost origins
adapter.timeoutScope: Fetch headers and body read; timer-driven, not a hard real-time guarantee

limits: No actual Supabase/PostgREST authentication or RLS test
No native Cloudflare Worker or Cache API execution
No provider/DNS/TLS/browser or alias tenant-identity verification
No global cache invalidation or concurrency guarantee
No body-size cap, multi-host redirect-cycle detection or forced termination guarantee for an uncooperative injected fetch
No merge, deployment, environment activation or production mutation
